title: 创世记 1:1–2
subtitle: CEV · Genesis 1:1-2
quote: 「起初，神创造了诸天和大地。大地空荒，毫无生命的形态；是被咆哮的海洋覆盖着的黑暗。但神的灵在水面上运行。」
quoteEn: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. The earth was barren, with no form of life; it was under a roaring ocean covered with darkness. But the Spirit of God was moving over the water.

title: 创世记 1:3–5 · 光与暗
subtitle: Genesis 1:3-5 · 含五卷书名
quote: 神說：「要有光」，就有了光。神看光是好的，就把光暗分開了。神稱光為晝，稱暗為夜。有晚上，有早晨，這是第一日。
quoteEn: And God said, "Let there be light," and there was light. And God saw that the light was good. And God separated the light from the darkness. God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, the first day.
